correctness.rationale: The source gives \(\phi_\rho^\dagger(y)=\rho y+y^{16}\), \((\operatorname{im}\phi_\rho)^\perp=\ker\phi_\rho^\dagger\), and singularity iff \(\rho^{21}=1\). For a singular parameter, nonzero adjoint-kernel vectors satisfy \(y^{15}=\rho\). The fifteenth-power kernel in \(\mathbb F_{64}^{\times}\) has size \(\gcd(15,63)=3\), exactly \(\mathbb F_4^\times\), so projective normals and singular parameters are in bijection. The hull criterion reduces to \(\operatorname{Tr}_{64/4}(y)=0\), and elimination gives \(\rho^5+\rho^4+1=0\). The standalone verifier exhaustively confirms the \(21\) hyperplanes, five roots, and \(60/5\) full-family split.
